sonic_energy.description: Perceptual measure of musical intensity, dynamic volume, distortion, and sound pressure level.
sonic_energy.derivation_source: Root-Mean-Square (RMS) Energy & Spectral Centroid Brightness via Librosa

codes.label: Explosive & Heavy
codes.definition: High-octane, heavy distortion, loud production, and maximum dynamic force (e.g. Hardcore, Grindcore, Metalcore).
codes.threshold: Librosa RMS > 0.12 or Spectral Centroid > 3200 Hz

codes.label: Driving & Energetic
codes.definition: Upbeat, driving rhythm, energetic instrumentation, and lively production (e.g. Punk Rock, Fast Ska, Upbeat Rock).
codes.threshold: Librosa RMS 0.055 - 0.12 or Spectral Centroid 2000 - 3200 Hz

codes.label: Moderate & Balanced
codes.definition: Mid-tempo, balanced volume, steady acoustic/electric arrangement (e.g. Indie Rock, Mid-tempo Alternative).

codes.label: Soft & Calm
codes.definition: Gentle, quiet production, intimate acoustic instruments, and subdued dynamics (e.g. Folk Ballads, Acoustic Solos, Ambient).

emotional_mood.description: Harmonic and emotional positivity conveyed by the musical arrangement and chord structures.
emotional_mood.derivation_source: Harmonic Chromagram & Tonnetz Major/Minor Key Ratios via Librosa

codes.label: Somber & Melancholic
codes.definition: Low positivity: minor-key, mournful, sad, elegiac, or desolate harmonic mood (e.g. Captivity Elegies, Slaughterhouse Laments).

codes.label: Serious & Intense
codes.definition: Mid-low positivity: serious, urgent, tense, or confrontational harmonic tone.

codes.label: Balanced & Neutral
codes.definition: Moderate positivity: neutral, storytelling, or reflective harmonic background.

codes.label: Uplifting & Positive
codes.definition: High positivity: major-key, cheerful, bright, encouraging, or triumphant feel (e.g. Celebration of Vegan Life).

rhythmic_style.description: Rhythmic regularity, danceability, beat strength, and tempo momentum.
rhythmic_style.derivation_source: Onset Strength Envelope Variance & Beat Onsets via Librosa

codes.label: Danceable Rhythm
codes.definition: High rhythmic regularity, strong danceable groove, and clear beat pulse (e.g. Funk, Ska, Hip-Hop, Pop).

codes.label: Driving Rhythm
codes.definition: Driving rock/punk/metal beat, fast double-kick, and steady rhythmic pulse.

codes.label: Atmospheric / Freeform
codes.definition: Loose beat structure, ambient soundscapes, spoken word monologues, or non-rhythmic passages.

acoustic_type.description: Primary instrumentation setup and acoustic vs electric/electronic sound spectrum.
acoustic_type.derivation_source: Spectral Flatness & Harmonic-Percussive Source Separation via Librosa

codes.label: Unplugged Acoustic
codes.definition: Unamplified acoustic instruments, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, and organic folk production.

codes.label: Semi-Acoustic Hybrid
codes.definition: Blend of acoustic and electric/electronic instruments (e.g. Acoustic guitar with electric drums/bass).

codes.label: Electric & Amplified
codes.definition: Electric guitars, bass, synthesizers, distorted amplifiers, and heavy studio production.

vocal_delivery.description: Style of vocal presentation and ratio of spoken word vs melodic singing.
vocal_delivery.derivation_source: Zero-Crossing Rate (ZCR) & High-Frequency Spectral Flux via Librosa

codes.label: Spoken Word & Rap
codes.definition: Spoken word monologues, rap, hip-hop, or spoken poetry.

codes.label: Spoken Sample & Vocal
codes.definition: Singing mixed with spoken speech samples (e.g. activist speeches, slaughterhouse audio samples).

codes.label: Melodic Singing
codes.definition: Standard melodic singing, clean vocal lines, screaming, or vocal melodies.

tempo_bpm.description: Exact musical speed and pace measured in Beats Per Minute.
tempo_bpm.derivation_source: Onset Autocorrelation Beat Tracking via Librosa
